_comment: Reference values for lammps-eam-lattice. Calibrated on x86_64 with compchem-bench/lammps-eam-lattice:ci (LAMMPS 7Jan2022, Mishin Cu EAM, box/relax from a=3.7 A).
_calibration_note: Minimization from a=3.7 A with fix box/relax converges deterministically (5 oracle runs identical): a0=3.614925 A, ecoh=-3.5402183 eV/atom. Headline tolerances per spec (0.005 A / 0.01 eV). L4 run-0 of final.data reproduces the log last line exactly (print precision); tol 1e-4 eV/atom. A hand-rolled a=3.60 A lattice misses by 2.2e-3 eV/atom -> forgery fails L4.
